title.narrative: Women Empowerment through the Justice System in Tajikistan (WEMJUST)

description.narrative: The overall objective of this Action is to contribute to gender equality, eradicate discrimination, and enhance human rights through equitable access to justice in Tajikistan. In order to achieve this goal the Action has two Specific Objectives (SOs): To foster and support women working in the justice system to strengthen their representation and role at all levels of the justice system (SO1); and to ensure greater access to justice in cases of violation of women and girls¿ rights by raising the capacity of the justice system to protect women and girls rights (SO2)
